name: Çorum

queries.query: Corum Turkey official cadastral parcel map land registry GIS
queries.result: First-party discovery found the official TKGM Parsel Sorgu service and the Çorum Municipality Kent Bilgi Sistemi parcel-map lead. The live TKGM client configuration exposed an anonymous coordinate parcel API; the exact WUP point returned a Çorum parcel polygon.

queries.query: Çorum Türkiye resmi kadastro parsel haritası tapu kadastro GIS
queries.result: Resmi keşif, TKGM Parsel Sorgu servisini ve Çorum Belediyesi Kent Bilgi Sistemi parsel haritası duyurusunu buldu. TKGM istemci yapılandırması anonim koordinat parsel API'sini gösterdi; tam WUP noktası Çorum'da bir parsel poligonu döndürdü.

officialSourceAssessment.localCustodian: Çorum Belediyesi Kent Bilgi Sistemi / municipal GIS lead; its official page advertises parcel information, while live harita.corum.bel.tr access timed out during this attempt.
officialSourceAssessment.nationalCadastreService: Tapu ve Kadastro Genel Müdürlüğü (TKGM) Parsel Sorgu / MEGSİS public service.
officialSourceAssessment.registryBasis: Local municipal parcel-map publication is evidenced by the official Çorum Municipality KBS page; the verified parcel response came from the official TKGM public cadastral service.
officialSourceAssessment.registryFoundReason: A local municipal cadastral/map service is actually evidenced, so registryFound is true; this does not imply that the municipal viewer's backend was independently qualified.

schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: Not declared in response; coordinates observed in GeoJSON [longitude, latitude] order and retained without reprojection.
schemaAndCrs.nativeIdentity: Composite source identity mahalleId=124404, adaNo=426, parselNo=28; no standalone parselId was returned.
schemaAndCrs.compositeKeyProvenance: The identity is composed from the exact TKGM feature properties returned for the coordinate query; it is not an internal row number.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: Exact coordinate query returned a polygon whose returned feature properties identify Çorum / Merkez / Yeniyol / ada 426 / parsel 28.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: TKGM national public cadastral parcel query plus Çorum Municipality KBS local parcel-map publication.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: One exact-point TKGM parcel feature in Çorum Merkez/Yeniyol; no citywide extent was tested.

serialReviewerQualification: required; research evidence is not source integration or admission
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point was preserved in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted.
One exact-point hit does not establish citywide coverage; no citywide absence or completeness claim is made.
No raw source-specific attribute set is retained in the sample; source fields and mapping are recorded only in metadata.
No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe field request, or TLS verification disablement was used.
uncertainty: The exact-point parcel feature is verified, but the local municipal viewer timed out and the TKGM response did not declare a CRS or standalone parcel ID. Independent serial review must qualify any adapter; runtime remains held.
